page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew lexicon page, set in parallel. Left column first, top to bottom, then right column top to bottom. Running head above each column. Page number at top right. Catchword at the foot of the right column. Thin stray marks in the left margin are show-through or the neighbouring page's edge and are not transcribed.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at reading resolution; the vowel points and dagesh on the dense small Hebrew forms are not reliably legible, so exact pointing of the Hebrew words should be checked against the original. Left margin marks are show-through or the neighbouring page's edge and are not printed text. The Hebrew lines are transcribed without verification of each point and may contain small errors.
